data.heading: What Agivant brings to TigerGraph
data.description: TigerGraph stores and traverses the connections. Agivant engineers everything around them: the data that feeds the graph, the schemas that shape it, the agents that act on what it shows, and the controls that keep people in charge.

blocks.body: Graph schema design mapped to the questions the business needs answered
Real-time ingestion pipelines that keep the graph current as transactions and events land
Multi-hop traversal logic written in GSQL and tuned for production load
GraphRAG grounding, so agent answers carry the relationships and context behind them
Human checkpoints in front of high-stakes decisions, with evaluation and rollback from the first sprint
Reusable schemas, traversal logic, ingestion pipelines, and agent patterns that carry into the next use case

data.heading: Where Agivant applies TigerGraph
data.description: Each of these starts with a question a row-level query struggles to answer.

blocks.title: Fraud ring detection
blocks.body: Organized fraud runs as a network of shared devices, addresses, accounts, and intermediaries. Agivant builds agents on TigerGraph that trace those links as transactions land and bring the ring to investigators while it is still active.
items: Multi-hop traversal across accounts, devices, locations, and transaction chains
Ring and anomaly detection as patterns form
Investigator review before any account action
blocks.solution: up to 60% reduction in fraud ring detection time and up to 35% of cases auto-prioritized by risk score

blocks.title:
Supply chain risk
intelligence
blocks.body: Organized fraud runs as a network of shared devices, addresses, accounts, and intermediaries. Agivant builds agents on TigerGraph that trace those links as transactions land and bring the ring to investigators while it is still active.
items: Disruption alerts with the full dependency chain
blocks.solution: up to 45% reduction in multi-tier risk exposure time and up to 80% of the supplier network mapped automatically

blocks.title:
Entity resolution and
customer 360
blocks.body: The same customer or counterparty shows up across CRM, billing, support, and compliance systems under different names and IDs. Agivant resolves those records into one entity in TigerGraph, so downstream agents reason over the whole relationship.
items: Golden record built in the graph
Shared entity layer for downstream agents
blocks.solution: up to 95% entity match accuracy across fragmented sources and up to 70% of duplicate entities resolved automatically

blocks.title:
Anti-money
laundering network
analysis
blocks.body: Laundering hides in layered transaction chains and ownership structures. Agivant traces fund flows and resolves beneficial ownership across the graph, then assembles an investigation-ready evidence trail for compliance analysts.
items: Compliance analyst sign-off on every case
blocks.solution: up to 50% reduction in investigation preparation time and up to 65% of fund flows traced automatically
